description: Gives how to cite a card or a solver: the service itself first (Zero-Trust Physics, its maker and its address) and the paper (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23305697), then the people whose measurements the model stands on (authors, title, year, address, and what each asks of those who use its data), each as text and BibTeX. With domain and card, or solver, the answer is for that model; with neither, it is how to cite the service itself: its name, who made it, its address and the paper.

domain.description: With card: a card, by the name find_model or list_cards gives; the two give the same names.

solver.description: In place of domain and card: a solver, by the name find_model or list_solvers gives.

name: cite
title: Cite
